name: Aboleth — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Aboleth from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Aboleth, Psionic" but are not part of the Aboleth entry, which is unchanged.

hp 84 (8d8+48)
Fort +8, Ref +5, Will +11

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., swim 60 ft.
Melee 4 tentacles +9 (1d6+5 plus slime)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 13th; concentration +16)

At will—compelling voice (DC 20, affects up to 6 creatures), ego whip (3d4, DC 19), false sensory input (DC 16, 5 targets), memory modification (DC 17), mindlink (DC 14, 5 targets, may target unwilling creatures), mind probe (DC 20), moment of terror (DC 16, imposes penalty on saving throws regardless of success)
